component.name: Steam Artwork for Non-Steam Games
component.summary: Artwork and icons for your non-Steam games

description.p: Gives the games you added to Steam yourself (emulators, GOG, itch.io, Heroic and Lutris installs) the same artwork as the rest of your library: cover, wide cover, banner, logo and icon.

It finds your Steam install on its own, lists every non-Steam shortcut, and fills in whatever is missing in one click, from SteamGridDB and from a game's official Steam store artwork. You can swap any piece from a visual picker, use animated artwork, use your own pictures, and undo any change. Steam's shortcut list is backed up before every write.
Works on desktop Linux and on the Steam Deck in desktop mode. A free SteamGridDB API key unlocks the most artwork. Not affiliated with Valve or SteamGridDB.
